source_title: DGP meet Saadatganj triple murder victims’ family; assure fast-track trial, security - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Lucknow: DGP Rajeev Krishna on Friday visited the residence of the victims of the Saadatganj triple murder, met the bereaved Tiwari family and assured them of security, a speedy trial and strict action against those found guilty.
